decisions.statement: An agent whose processes form one tree has outlived no tree.
The tree kept is the tree with the stated keeper.
The tree kept where no keeper is stated is the tree holding the newest process.
A process the caller is running in is never read as another agent's process.
The invocation a caller runs inside reaches up to the nearest agent process.

definition: an agent's processes: which whole trees it has outlived, and which are the caller's own
